spans.text:
Any asset slot whose `asset_plan` intent implies a real photograph MUST reference
the absolute path to a real local PNG produced by `sn-image-generate`.
Do NOT use `<svg>` placeholders, empty `<div>` blocks, grey squares, or text like "配图待补".
spans.note: The prompt explicitly requires that real photograph slots must reference actual local PNG files and prohibits the use of placeholders, empty blocks, grey squares, or placeholder text. This enforces content integrity and prevents fabrication of visual assets.
